name: agent-screen
description: OS-level screenshot primitive for non-web Visual QA and installed-app dogfood. Captures a real desktop PNG explicitly on demand, preferring Windows host capture from WSL with window inventory, DWM bounds, timeout-guarded screen/window targeting, explicit minimized-window restore, active-window fallback, and blank-frame warnings; falls back to ffmpeg x11grab plus X11 window helpers. V1 is screenshot-only; bounded screen recording is deliberately deferred.
